sql:
SELECT co.name AS empresa, count(*) AS festas_desde_abril,
       count(e.lead_id) AS com_lead,
       round(100.0 * count(e.lead_id) / count(*)) AS pct_com_lead,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.data_fechamento_venda IS NOT NULL) AS com_data_venda
FROM public.company_events e JOIN public.companies co ON co.id = e.company_id
WHERE e.status <> 'cancelado' AND e.created_at >= '2026-04-01'
GROUP BY co.name ORDER BY 2 DESC
